# Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(UpSetR)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(
  "point",
  list(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)
)
```

```{r}
source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")
source("../scripts/functions/nice_plots.R")
source("../scripts/functions/run_de_analysis.R")
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")
```

## Load data

```{r}
metadata <- read_csv("../data/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/data_wide.csv")
```

```{r}
data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% c("DA05925", "DA06048"))
```

# Differential protein analysis

## Grouped HIV-1 (baseline) vs. Healthy

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up") |> 
  filter(Subcategory != "Elite Controller") |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)
```

```{r}
hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")
```

```{r}
de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Disease", 
                          case = "HIV", 
                          control = "Healthy", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex", "BMI")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = FALSE,
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy <- de_results$de_res
```

```{r}
p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p
ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot HIV vs healthy.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot HIV vs healthy cut.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7)
```

## Grouped HIV-1 (follow-up) vs. Healthy

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Baseline") |> 
  filter(Subcategory != "Elite Controller") |>

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)
```

```{r}

                        metadata = input_metadata,

                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")
```

```{r}

  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = FALSE,
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,

head(de_results$de_res)

de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy_fu <- de_results$de_res
```

```{r}
p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
```

## Combine volcano plots

```{r}
sii_healthy_volcano <- p_volcano_severely_healthy
mpi_healthy_volcano <- p_volcano_preserved_healthy
phi_healthy_volcano <- p_volcano_early_healthy
ec_healthy_volcano  <- p_volcano_elite_healthy
```

```{r}
phi_healthy_volcano + ggtitle("Primary HIV infection vs. healthy") + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  mpi_healthy_volcano + ggtitle("More preserved immunity vs. healthy") + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  sii_healthy_volcano + ggtitle("Severely impaired immunity vs. healthy") + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ec_healthy_volcano + ggtitle("Elite controllers vs. healthy") + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plots all vs healthy.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 24,
  height   = 7)
```

# Subgroups (follow-up) vs. healthy

### Primary HIV infection vs. healthy

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Baseline") |> 
  filter(Subcategory %in% c("Primary HIV Infection", "Healthy")) |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid) |>
  # Remove FOLR3?? Clear outlier and isoform and low amount of samples
  select(-FOLR3)
```

```{r}
hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")
```

```{r}
de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Disease", 
                          case = "HIV", 
                          control = "Healthy", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex", "BMI")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = FALSE,
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)
```

```{r}
p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_early_healthy_fu <- p

  filename = "Volcano plot early infection vs healthy follow-up.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot early infection vs healthy follow-up.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)
```

# Follow-up vs. Baseline

## Updating limma function

```{r}
hd_de_limma_paired <- function(dat,
                               metadata = NULL,
                               variable = "Disease",
                               case,
                               control = NULL,
                               correct = NULL,
                               log_transform = FALSE,
                               paired = FALSE,
                               id_column = "ID") {

  Variable <- rlang::sym(variable)

  # ----------------------------
  # Input handling
  # ----------------------------
  if (inherits(dat, "HDAnalyzeR")) {
    wide_data <- dat$data
    metadata  <- dat$metadata
    sample_id <- dat$sample_id
  } else {
    wide_data <- dat
    sample_id <- colnames(dat)[1]
  }

  if (is.null(metadata)) stop("Metadata must be provided.")
  if (!variable %in% colnames(metadata)) stop("Variable not found in metadata.")
  if (paired && !id_column %in% colnames(metadata))
    stop("id_column must exist in metadata when paired = TRUE.")

  if (log_transform) {
    wide_data <- hd_log_transform(wide_data)
  }

  if (is.null(control)) {
    control <- setdiff(unique(metadata[[variable]]), case)
  }

  variable_type <- hd_detect_vartype(metadata[[variable]], unique_threshold = 2)

  # ----------------------------
  # Join data
  # ----------------------------
  meta_cols <- c(sample_id, variable, correct)
  if (paired) meta_cols <- c(meta_cols, id_column)

  join_data <- wide_data |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      metadata |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(meta_cols)),
      by = sample_id
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!!Variable %in% c(case, control)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!dplyr::if_any(dplyr::all_of(c(variable, correct)), is.na))

  # Force factor with correct levels
  if (variable_type == "categorical") {
    join_data[[variable]] <- factor(
      join_data[[variable]],
      levels = c(control, case)
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # Build design
  # ----------------------------
  formula <- paste0("~0 + ", variable)

  if (!is.null(correct)) {
    var_types <- sapply(metadata[correct], hd_detect_vartype)
    for (v in correct) {
      term <- if (var_types[v] == "categorical") {
        paste0("as.factor(", v, ")")
      } else {
        v
      }
      formula <- paste(formula, "+", term)
    }
  }

  design <- model.matrix(as.formula(formula), data = join_data)
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

  # ----------------------------
  # Expression matrix
  # ----------------------------
  data_fit <- join_data |>
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c(variable, correct, id_column))) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames(sample_id) |>
    t()

  # ----------------------------
  # Fit model
  # ----------------------------
  if (paired) {

    block <- join_data[[id_column]]

    dupcor <- limma::duplicateCorrelation(
      data_fit,
      design,
      block = block
    )

    fit <- limma::lmFit(
      data_fit,
      design,
      block = block,
      correlation = dupcor$consensus.correlation
      # ⚠️ robust disabled by design
    )

  } else {

    fit <- limma::lmFit(
      data_fit,
      design,
      method = "robust",
      maxit = 10000
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # Contrasts (categorical only)
  # ----------------------------
  if (variable_type == "categorical") {

    case_col    <- make.names(paste0(variable, case))
    control_col <- make.names(paste0(variable, control))

    if (!all(c(case_col, control_col) %in% colnames(design))) {
      stop(
        "Case/control columns not found in design matrix.\n",
        "Expected: ", case_col, ", ", control_col, "\n",
        "Found: ", paste(colnames(design), collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    contrast <- limma::makeContrasts(
      contrasts = paste0(case_col, " - ", control_col),
      levels = design
    )

    fit <- limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # Empirical Bayes
  # ----------------------------
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

  # ----------------------------
  # Output
  # ----------------------------
  de_res <- limma::topTable(
    fit,
    n = Inf,
    adjust.method = "fdr",
    confint = TRUE
  ) |>
    tibble::as_tibble(rownames = "Feature") |>
    dplyr::arrange(adj.P.Val)

  out <- list(de_res = de_res)
  class(out) <- "hd_de"

  return(out)
}
```

### Primary HIV infection paired

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Subcategory %in% "Primary HIV Infection") |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI)) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  # Mutate Follow-up to FU in Timepoint
  mutate(Timepoint = ifelse(Timepoint == "Follow-up", "FU", Timepoint))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)
```

```{r}
hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")
```

```{r}
de_results <- hd_de_limma_paired(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Timepoint", 
                          case = "FU", 
                          control = "Baseline", 
                          correct = c("BMI"),
                          paired = TRUE,
                          id_column = "ID") |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 5,
                  top_down_prot = 10,
                  title = FALSE,
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_primary_paired <- de_results$de_res
```

```{r}
p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_early_healthy_paired <- p

  filename = "Volcano plot early infection vs healthy paired.pdf",

  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot early infection vs healthy paired.png",

  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)
```

```{r}
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
```
